scope: Eight derivative rows, six distinct sequences in three complete-frame contrasts. A verified primary plate, derivative photo crops and secondary drawings are explicitly separated below.

independent_primary_source.citation: Joshi and Parpola1987, CISI1, printedp70 / PDFp106
independent_primary_source.cropping: M289a impression crop from original PDF at6x, page fractions [.53,.565,.82,.79]. No mirroring or retouching.

observations.observation: Labelled original M289A and normalized impression M289a are both present. The impression shows a jar, bent/seated figure with projecting lower/back strokes, a whiskered fish, a short upper stroke pair and a decorated diamond. All five broad graphic units are visible, in the candidate visual order. The tiger and trough occur below the text.
observations.broad_shape_correspondence: Compatible with the selected frame and distinct from nested curved parentheses.
observations.fine_code_limit: The graphic family is observed, but an independent Wells fine-variant assignment for176 versus177–179 and817 versus861 has not been established. Do not describe this as exact independent numeric transcription.

observations.evidence_level: Derivative photographic crops, same Lipi maintainer; primary plate not acquired
observations.observation: CropA retains label H697A and shows jar, nested curved strokes, whiskered fish, upper short pair and diamond in visual LTR order. CropB shows a bull plus a multi-stroke cluster on the reverse. The nested curves are graphically distinct from the bent/seated figure on primary M289a.
observations.provenance_limit: No official CISI2 plate has been acquired. The labelled crops are useful photographic witnesses but do not supply independent provenance verification or museum/object identity.

observations.evidence_level: Derivative photographic crop, same Lipi maintainer; primary plate not acquired
observations.observation: The crop retains label Ad3A and is a seal original, so its visible sequence is mirrored relative to normalized impression order. It shows a hat-bearing fish, central-stroke U, tall stroke cluster, nested curved strokes and jar, which reverses to the candidate visual sequence. A unicorn and stand occur below.
observations.provenance_limit: Requires official CISI2 or Fairservis1976 excavation report for independent photographic and archaeological verification.

prior_depiction.observation: Ad3 and H2139 are depicted as adjacent rows with the same complete frame and this glyph contrast. Literature is checking whether the author explicitly proposed their substitution; a prior drawing alone is enough to prevent claiming the contrast was previously unseen.

claim_boundary: The current evidence supports graphic distinctness and one photo-supported complete-frame correspondence(M289/H697, with H697 derivative provenance). It does not establish semantic interchangeability, sound values, synonymy or a decipherment. Three fully independent primary complete-frame contrasts have not yet been verified.
